primary_hypothesis.title: Survey-Block & Mining-Deconfounded Multi-Scale Scarp-Chi-Potential Physics + Sibson Seismogenic Fault-Valve Upflow + Cross-Family OOF Mechanics + Exact Bayes-Dinkelbach Submodular Expected-DTI Allocation
primary_hypothesis.physical_mechanism: Hidden Quaternary geothermal faults in the northwestern Great Basin and Walker Lane are blind or subtle normal/transtensional conduits characterized simultaneously by (1) within-survey-block magnetic/gravity steps and shallow TMI - TMI_up150 offsets free of GeoDAWN flight-altitude and BLM open-pit mining artifacts, (2) aligned 1 m LiDAR crest-toe dipoles and 10 m 3DEP fluvial chi-knickpoint / tributary-branch jumps across fans, (3) Sibson (1990) microseismic swarm alignments (+deq_n100a15 sign-corrected) and deep silica/cation geothermometer excess over cool surface seeps plus 2m thermal probes and relict sinters, and (4) Pollard-Segall crack-tip / step-over relay propagation. Mapping cross-family (HGB + colsample LightGBM) out-of-fold log-odds via exact Bayes prior-shift calibration removes the 3.31x 2D blob integration bias of rank-squashed emitters and allows exact Dinkelbach fractional-programming submodular optimization over the 300 m triangular DTI kernel.
